standard-bots.title: Standard Bots
standard-bots.lead: Industrial robot arms for factories that want automation without the drama.
standard-bots.body: Standard Bots builds approachable industrial robots for manufacturing floors. Content and SEO supported product education and category demand around factory automation.

hicomply.title: HiComply
hicomply.body: HiComply helps companies run security and compliance programs without drowning in spreadsheets. Engagement focused on SEO and educational content around frameworks and audit readiness.

switchboard.title: Switchboard
switchboard.body: Switchboard explored spatial collaboration for remote work. Brand and product storytelling work sat alongside early go-to-market experiments.

metaphysiks.title: Metaphysiks
metaphysiks.lead: Swiss wellness and metaphysics studio site.
metaphysiks.body: Metaphysiks is a boutique wellness / metaphysics practice. Work covered a clean marketing site and brand presentation for an international audience.

instaffo.title: Instaffo
instaffo.lead: Talent marketplace connecting companies with vetted specialists.
instaffo.body: Instaffo matches companies with freelancers and specialists across Europe. SEO and content supported talent-marketplace demand and category education.

bestever.lead: AI creative platform for performance marketers.

notch-so.title: Notch.so
notch-so.lead: Modern website tooling for growing brands.
notch-so.body: Notch helps teams ship and iterate marketing sites faster. Organic content and SEO covered site ops and Webflow-adjacent workflows.

newsbreak.title: Newsbreak
newsbreak.lead: Local news and content discovery platform.
newsbreak.body: Newsbreak distributes local and national news to a large consumer audience. Content strategy work supported discovery and topical coverage.

lantern.title: Lantern
lantern.lead: Insurance products with a clearer customer experience.
lantern.body: Lantern Insurance modernizes how people buy coverage. SEO and content work focused on trust, education, and comparison intent.

meter.title: Meter
meter.lead: Enterprise network infrastructure — ISP, Wi‑Fi, switches, security.
meter.body: Meter sells and operates modern network stacks for offices and campuses. Content and SEO work focused on infrastructure and managed-network demand.

bestow.title: Bestow
bestow.body: Bestow sells life insurance online with a streamlined underwriting flow. Content and SEO supported education around term life and digital insurance.

banxware.title: Banxware

pult.title: Pult

workos.title: WorkOS
workos.lead: Enterprise-ready auth and user management APIs.
workos.body: WorkOS helps SaaS companies add SSO, SCIM, and directory sync. Content and SEO spoke to developers adopting enterprise features.

elevenlabs.title: ElevenLabs
elevenlabs.body: ElevenLabs powers realistic AI speech for products and creators. Brand and content work supported category leadership in generative voice.

fiverr.title: Fiverr
fiverr.body: Fiverr connects businesses with freelancers worldwide. Content and SEO collaboration focused on the blog and service-discovery demand.

voy-tax.title: Voy.Tax
voy-tax.body: Voy helps people navigate tax and legal workflows with a clearer digital experience. Site and content work emphasized trust and clarity.

lindy-ai.title: Lindy.ai
lindy-ai.lead: AI assistant platform for founders and ops teams.
lindy-ai.body: Lindy is an AI agent platform for inbox, research, and ops automation. Work spanned SEO content and site growth against assistant / automation demand.

ai-apply.title: AI Apply
ai-apply.body: AI Apply helps candidates tailor applications faster with AI. Organic content covered job-search and application-automation intent.

Blaze helps healthcare, finance, and logistics teams ship internal apps without engineers — with SOC 2 Type 2 and HIPAA-ready deployments as the trust spine.

At masse we ran SEO + editorial content against healthcare and HIPAA demand, with a heavy backlink program alongside Meta acquisition. The `/healthcare` cluster became the site's primary organic engine.

circles.title: Circles
circles.body: Circles builds community-centered product experiences. Engagement covered marketing site clarity and growth content.

contract-hero.title: Contract Hero
contract-hero.body: Contract Hero streamlines contract workflows for businesses. SEO and content targeted legal-ops and contract-management demand.

exacare.title: ExaCare

filmless.title: Filmless

longbow.title: Longbow
longbow.body: Longbow partners with companies on growth and delivery work. Site presentation focused on clarity of offer and proof.

orb.title: Orb

firecrawl.title: Firecrawl
firecrawl.lead: Web data API for AI agents and apps.
firecrawl.body: Firecrawl turns websites into clean, LLM-ready data. Engagement covered product storytelling and organic demand around scraping, crawl APIs, and agent tooling.

tdem.title: TDEM
tdem.body: TDEM coordinates emergency preparedness and response for Texas. Digital work focused on clear public information architecture.

trafficguard.title: Trafficguard
trafficguard.lead: Ad fraud prevention and traffic quality.
